story.headline: Basel lose 0:3 on Jokanovic debut
story.summary: Basel lost 0:3 at newly promoted Vaduz (a Liechtenstein club playing in the Swiss league) in the first competitive game under new coach Slavisa Jokanovic
story.display_body: Basel lost 0:3 at newly promoted Vaduz (a Liechtenstein club playing in the Swiss league) in the first competitive game under new coach Slavisa Jokanovic. It is Basel's first defeat of the season after 3 wins and 1 draw in their previous games, and it drops them to 7th. Two goals from Marcel Monsberger inside ten minutes settled it. Jokanovic had already called his side "amateurish" after a 3:7 friendly loss to Winterthur during the international break. Earlier the same day, Young Boys won 2:0 at Grasshoppers, only their second clean sheet this season. SRF puts YB six points behind league leaders Lugano, so the title picture is Lugano ahead with the traditional heavyweights unsettled. The league now pauses for the Swiss Cup, with Basel at Stade Nyonnais on 2026-10-16.
story.why: The Swiss title race is unusually open, and the club most expected to challenge, Basel, now has a coaching reset and a crisis of form.

story.headline: Man City win 3:0 at Anfield amid ruling
story.summary: Manchester City beat Liverpool 3:0 (goals from Haaland, Doku and Cherki) in their first game since an independent commission found them guilty of 114 charges of breaching Premier League financial rule
story.display_body: Manchester City beat Liverpool 3:0 (goals from Haaland, Doku and Cherki) in their first game since an independent commission found them guilty of 114 charges of breaching Premier League financial rules between 2009-10 and 2017-18. The win leaves City three points clear at the top. City have appealed, and sanctions, which BBC Sport says have been floated as anything from a record points deduction to relegation, have not been decided. BBC's Phil McNulty argues every result now carries an "asterisk" until the appeal and penalty are settled, and no one knows when that will be. These are the club's contested findings under appeal, not final sanctions.
story.why: If a heavy penalty eventually lands, the table being played out now could be rewritten, which makes the title race provisional.

story.headline: Antonelli nears title after Singapore GP
story.summary: Max Verstappen won in Singapore for the first time at his tenth attempt, 7.3 seconds clear of Charles Leclerc
story.display_body: Max Verstappen won in Singapore for the first time at his tenth attempt, 7.3 seconds clear of Charles Leclerc. The bigger story is the championship: Mercedes' Kimi Antonelli, third, leads team-mate George Russell (ninth after starting 19th) by 102 points, 340 to 238. With 25 points for a win and five rounds left after the United States Grand Prix in Austin, Antonelli can clinch there. The simplest route is to win while Russell finishes ninth or lower; the tie is then broken on race wins (Antonelli has eight to Russell's three). Ferrari's Lewis Hamilton lost a likely podium after staying out during a virtual safety car (a slow-down period under which pit stops are cheap), which Hamilton took the blame for. Standings: Hamilton 229, Verstappen 221, Leclerc 215, Norris 201; points per Autosport's analysis (single outlet).
story.why: The 2026 title is effectively decided, and the open question is the date, with Austin the first chance.

story.headline: FIA admits Singapore qualifying error
story.summary: After a red flag, race control failed to re-enable the cars' overtake mode in time, then briefly switched it back on for 27 seconds before turning it off again
story.display_body: After a red flag, race control failed to re-enable the cars' overtake mode in time, then briefly switched it back on for 27 seconds before turning it off again. Drivers eliminated in that phase of qualifying felt they were hurt unfairly. FIA single-seater director Nikolas Tombazis called it "the worst thing" for the federation and "a bit of a mess, quite frankly", blaming a missed on-screen prompt under time pressure. He said the error affected some drivers more than others.
story.why: It is the sport's governing body admitting that a procedural slip altered a competitive result.

story.headline: Zheng wins China Open as wildcard
story.summary: Zheng Qinwen, a wildcard (an invited entry) ranked 54th, beat fourth seed Mirra Andreeva 7-5 6-4 to become the first Chinese woman to win the event
story.display_body: Zheng Qinwen, a wildcard (an invited entry) ranked 54th, beat fourth seed Mirra Andreeva 7-5 6-4 to become the first Chinese woman to win the event. It is her first WTA 1000 title (the tour's top tier below the Grand Slams) and ends a two-year title drought after elbow surgery last year; she climbs 31 places in the rankings.
story.why: A comeback from injury at home, and a swing in the rankings ahead of the season's final stretch.
